extractionProvider: Source-faithful SRD/D&DTools/RealmsHelps and archived source references discovered via Exa
notes: This batch covers Epic Ranger (Epic Level Handbook) through Guardian Paramount.
Epic Level Handbook 3.0 continuations remain independent from Dungeon Master's Guide v3.5 epic records.
Same-name source variants remain independent, including Epic Rogue, Epic Sorcerer, Epic Wizard, Exotic Weapon Master, Eye of Gruumsh, Frenzied Berserker and Geomancer.
No record was promoted to mechanically complete without reviewed automation and regression evidence.
